archetype: quantitative grid plus matched trajectory comparisons
core_conclusion: Determine whether the prescribed residual decoder improves frozen Stage3B motion-sensitive prediction; the conclusion follows the locked paired evaluation.

evidence_chain.main: Overall and major-class minFDE plus paired scene-bootstrap deltas
evidence_chain.motion: moving/parked vehicle and low/moving pedestrian subgroup gains and risks
evidence_chain.router: unnamed learned expert probabilities, no assigned static/dynamic semantics
evidence_chain.bins: all five frozen pedestrian bins, with counts
evidence_chain.cases: four purposive matched actor comparisons, including degradation; source trajectories unchanged

source_data: full-precision CSV and per-case JSON derived from frozen checkpoints; rounded labels only
statistics: one training seed2022; official TRAIN700/VAL150; paired scene-cluster 1000 resamples seed2022; 95% percentile CI for E-B; overlapping actor-windows clustered by scene; secondary CIs descriptive, no multiple-comparison correction
review_risks: Do not confuse FDE with top1 FDE
Do not imply causality from routing correlations
Do not use GT bins as model inputs
Do not interpret purposive improvement cases as population effects
Keep paired CI around delta rather than absolute unpaired error bars
